name: Rovo Dev
desc: Atlassian's coding agent for CLI, IDE and Jira.
desc_zh: Atlassian 的编码智能体，可在终端、IDE 和 Jira 里用
solves: Coding agents lack the ticket and spec behind a task. Rovo Dev pulls Jira work items, Confluence context and Bitbucket changes into the job.
solves_zh: 编码智能体看不到任务背后的工单和文档。Rovo Dev 把 Jira 工作项、Confluence 背景和 Bitbucket 改动带进任务里。
best_for: You pick up a Jira ticket and want an agent that already knows the spec and the repo.
best_for_zh: 你接手一张 Jira 工单，想要一个已经读过文档和代码库的智能体。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.atlassian.com/blog/company-news archive, then https://www.atlass）。 The date is the Team '25 announcement (2025-04-09), where the post calls them 'Rovo Dev Agents' in beta; the quote is cut before the following words because the page inserts spacing around a link. I did not find a separate dated post for the Rovo Dev CLI as such, so the first day the CLI itself was usable is not confirmed (medium confidence). Later surfaces of the same product: VS Code GA 2026-02-12, inside Jira 2026-04-02 (https://www.atlassian.com/blog/company-news/rovo-dev-in-jira). A third-party article claims Rovo Dev is being folded into Jira subscriptions; that was not confirmed on an Atlassian page. Distinct from the ledger's Atlassian Rovo (2024-10-09). No media source was read. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.atlassian.com/blog/rovo/team25-rovo-for-all
